from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudicialDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as appearing in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudicialDocument]
